messages.content_text:
DAY 13  : 1 TRADE 1 BE

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
We looked overall bearish after 6:45, price tapped 4H RB and it was in OTE and aligned with 15 min FVG. found SMT and went with ES as it was the weaker pair. the breaker aligned with 10am KO. which in hindsight, i should have set my entry there.  set a limit on the breaker which aligned with 0.62, stop above breaker. got tapped in, andprice delivered to -2.25 and retraced and stopped me out. i was convinced that price would deliver to the -4 range because of the REL on NQ, but i was wrong. There was a 4H RB on ES's side that i missed. should have had my eyes more open on that possibility. was only looking for external liquidity draws. If the stop wasn't so big i would have just targeted -2, which in hindsight would have been the perfect trade. it seems that this execution has cost me a win. 

Psychological Analysis
This was the most promising trade and also the most frustrating one i've had so far. I had a possible clear TP, with 1200 which would have put me positive for the first time in forever. I opted to just go to -4. Would this be greed? It seemed quite fair to me. After seeing this, i was quite frustrated. I'm still frustrated as i'm writing this. I had my hopes up that this will be my first winning trade, but nope. Even pissed me off more that one apex account got liquidated for no reason. i luckily know not to revenge trade after shit like this. Its just so aggravating. today felt like the perfect day to turn around my losing streak and i just got the finger from price. (edited)

messages.author: djimon
messages.content_text:
DAY9: 19.05.2026 - 09:54 - 09:54 + 10:30 - 10:30 AM | 1 L (-$262.50) + 1 L (-$480 - taken on both accounts so /2 ) | 3 ES + 1 NQ
-----------------------------------------------------

i was bearish today because we had stacked lows close to market open, bearish structure and unfilled weekly gap underneath. the first trade i took today was before 10AM on ES. NY opened and we manipulated up into a 15m fvg touched CE and made a 5m bearish RB. ES was lagging behind at that time and i dont know why i took the trade on ES tbh i think because it was closer to this 5m rb than NQ. The 5m RB also rejected OTE perfectly. i got filled and instantly stopped out instantly. I could have anticapeted and waited for that SMT to happen tbh also it was really close before 10 AM so couldve just waited on that as well. mid trade really also from my side but im not mad im still learning so thats why i journal here so it wont happen again.

then 10AM opened and just dumped with only 6 pts manipulation above which i dont count as manipulation really. We still had not taken PDL and the weekly gap on both assets so i wanted to see that happen first. After we did that i did not really had any level for market to go to further down so i waited for ES to take the PDL as well and waited for a 5m RB to form. After we got one i scaled down to 1m to look for a 1m ET. I took the first one that formed because it rejected a 1m fvg and OTE and it was only 3pts away from the 5m rb CE which i counted as mitigated. so i took the trade when price came down into the 1m RB at 10:30 but got stopped out immediately.

retroperspectively the rb i took was not really a good one because it really did not show good rejection like the one that formed afterwards which also mitigated CE of the 5m RB. I forward tested this one with entry 1pt above its CE and it kinda delivered a little bit. but idk delivery was not as expected today i take these 2 losses. (edited)
